# LNT001 `suppression-without-reason`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

An inline suppression `! fobis: ignore[ID]` gives no reason.

## Why

A suppression silences a finding forever; without a reason, nobody can later tell whether it is
still justified. Write the reason after the bracket: `! fobis: ignore[COR020] state kept on purpose`.

## Reported

```fortran
real :: total = 0.0  ! fobis: ignore[COR020]
```

## Preferred

```fortran
real :: total = 0.0  ! fobis: ignore[COR020] running total across calls is intended
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[LNT001] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = LNT001` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).
